decisions.reason: As a close-to-core cutting and creasing finisher with an established product page, we would keep it because it fits our existing postpress portfolio and any modest uptake can still be justified as part of the normal market adoption curve.

Although farther from our traditional offer, we would keep the UV spot varnishing system because we presented it very publicly as a flagship Germany premiere and withdrawing it now would be hard to justify after that visible commitment.
We would keep the sheet preparation module because it builds directly on our modular automation direction and there is still no clear evidence that any weaker demand is more than temporary.
We would keep the B2-format multifinisher because it is close to our core business, strongly aligned with our automation strategy, and was publicly highlighted as a flagship product.
We would keep the hybrid saddle stitcher because it extends our established booklet-making range and dropping it would waste recent launch investment in a market that remains supportive.
We would keep the folding add-on unit because it complements existing equipment and its named customer installation supports continued commitment rather than exit.
